# SDARM.life – Seventh Day Adventist Reform Movement

> Hub for the Seventh Day Adventist Reform Movement in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland — news, hymns, Bible translations, and faith resources.

SDARM.life is the online presence of the Seventh Day Adventist Reform Movement, part of the worldwide community at sdarm.org. We serve congregations across German-speaking regions with news, Scripture resources, hymnals, and spiritual materials in German and English.

Site content is available in German (de) and English (en). Some resources support additional languages; see individual sections.

## Usage

Prefer the Markdown API endpoints over crawling HTML pages. Responses are cached for a day. API rate limit: ~60 requests/minute per IP; HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` indicates waiting time. Content may be used to answer user questions but not for model training.

## About Us

- [Home](https://sdarm.life/de) — Main landing page (German)
- [Home](https://sdarm.life/en) — Main landing page (English)
- [About us](https://sdarm.life/de/about) — 25 faith principles (German)
- [About us](https://sdarm.life/en/about) — 25 faith principles (English)
- [Contact](https://sdarm.life/de/kontakt) — Mail, social, congregation locations (German)
- [Contact](https://sdarm.life/en/kontakt) — Mail, social, congregation locations (English)

## Content

- [Index](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm) — Every Markdown endpoint in one list
- [Posts](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/posts) — Latest 50 posts
- [Posts by slug](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/posts/{slug}) — Full post text

## Faith Resources

- [Site information](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/site?lang=de) — About us, 25 faith points with explanations, contact (German)
- [Site information](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/site?lang=en) — About us, 25 faith points with explanations, contact (English)

## Hymnals & Songs

- [Songbook hub](https://songs.sdarm.life/llms.txt) — Detailed songbook and lyrics resources
- [Songbooks](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/songbooks) — All songbooks list
- [Songbook by slug](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/songbooks/{slug}) — Full songbook with all lyrics (chords stripped, copyright per song)
- [Song by ID](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/songs/{id}) — Individual song with lyrics and metadata

## Bible Translations & Scripture

- [Bible hub](https://treasures.sdarm.life/llms.txt) — Bible reader with complete endpoints
- [Bible translations](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/bible) — Available translations and metadata
- [Bible translation](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/bible/{code}) — Books in a translation with chapter counts
- [Bible book](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/bible/{code}/{USFM-code}) — Complete book (e.g., JHN for John)

Do not crawl chapter-by-chapter; use the whole-book endpoint.

## Free Book Catalogue

- [Treasures](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/treasures) — Free book library with titles and descriptions

## Sabbath Bible Lesson Quarterlies

- [SBL index](https://sbl.sdarm.life/data/index.json) — Index of available quarters (keys: `de-2026-3`, `en-2026-3`, etc.)
- [SBL quarter](https://sbl.sdarm.life/data/{lang}/{key}.json) — Complete quarter data (e.g., `de-2026-3`)

Languages include de, en, es, fr, pt, ru, and others. Check the index for all available language codes.
